events.title: About this game.
events.summary: Hello!Now that there's a next fest going on, and somehow there's some people checking out my game, I wanted to tell a little bit about it. This is a solo project almost entirely made by me. Sometimes my partner helps me with errors or creates tools for me on his free time. But the majority of coding is created by me, using visual scripting. And all art is being drawn by me, the biggest problem is being consistent. events.summary: Decorations are here.Finally, after a lot of head scratching and thinking and drawing, I've applied decorations in the game with pretty much the vision I had. Every flavor will have (for now) up to 10 unique decorations to them that you can pretty much rotate, move and change order freely.
